presentation.title: Aurelian Stock
presentation.premise: An Aurelian detachment sent to reclaim inherited machines from Tessell. Your crews trust their superior technology. Each warrant brings them closer to the people their orders would dispossess.
presentation.strength: Advanced energy weapons, precise fire and well-serviced machines. Capture and hold the evidence that moves the campaign forward.
presentation.tradeoff: Heat and expensive repairs punish careless attacks. Local yards cannot sell replacement Aurelian weapons; optional tender recovery earns scarce supplies.

nodes.name: First Warrant
nodes.brief: The Custody Tender's quartermaster Ada Rusk has a service cart stranded on Apron Seven behind a local cordon. Clear the Tender's approach and recover its crated Focused Large Laser. The warranty is useful only if Rusk can get it to your bay. Use superior reach; the ravines let lighter defenders reach your sides. Repairs remain on your account.

rewards.label: Rusk’s service cart: Focused Large Laser
rewards.afterword: Ada Rusk delivers the recovered service-cart optic under signed custody, separate from enemy salvage. Swap one Halberd Large Laser for it: the same five tonnes and two boxes, longer reach, hotter shots and a slower cycle. Name the saved variant Long Watch. At Cutbank, use the extra reach without letting the whole lance overheat in the avenue.

nodes.name: The Unbroken Chain
nodes.brief: The first warrant leaves two civil service posts unrecorded. Heavy transport cannot land on their terrace: take one machine up to 50 tonnes. A Votive can read the western route without engaging the road guard. This optional survey locates a service tender while the main warrant route remains open.

rewards.label: Dispatch ledger: Deep Scanner
rewards.afterword: The Tender releases a Deep Scanner from survey stock against the copied dispatch ledger. This is supplied equipment, not a recovered hostile component.

nodes.name: Under Civil Seal
nodes.brief: The survey locates a stranded tender on the landing supply perimeter. Protect its loading stand, secure cargo control and hold both through the transfer with up to 135 tonnes and three machines. The optional seal cabinet releases specialist stock.

rewards.label: Tender stock: two Focused Medium Lasers
rewards.afterword: The closed transfer releases two crated Focused Medium Lasers to the company. Their custody papers permit fitting; they do not erase repair costs.

rewards.label: Seal cabinet: burst optics and workshop access
rewards.afterword: The cabinet carries two Medium Burst Lasers and secures access to the workshop. Quoted repairs finish immediately after payment. The burst optics trade reach for close-range accuracy.

nodes.name: Custody Posts
nodes.brief: At Cutbank's posts on Sarn Avenue, registrar Len Saye refuses to leave the original repair rolls. Take both posts intact so the clerks can copy them. The fixed gun covers the centre; gardens and workshop streets reach its sides. Rusk's recovered optic can support from farther back, but it cannot fire through cover.

rewards.label: Custody allocation: Large Burst Laser
rewards.afterword: The Tender authorises a heavy burst emitter after the posts are secured. It trades the focused optics' reach for more reliable close-range fire. Cooling remains the limiting factor.

nodes.name: Sarn Inventory
nodes.brief: Len Saye carries the disputed signatures into Sarn Registry Court. Hold it for the custody copy while local crews attack from both access streets. The temporary loadway admits 175 tonnes: choose which of your four machines stays with the Tender. Take a heavy firing line or keep the Votive's fast eyes; heat and exposed sides remain liabilities.

rewards.label: Archive allocation: Extended Arc Projector
rewards.afterword: The completed inventory qualifies the company for a long-range arc projector. Its reach is an advantage; firing it beside your existing emitters can overwhelm the reactor cooling.

nodes.name: Root Exchange
nodes.brief: Take a two-machine verification detail between the lower, middle and crown readers on the service terraces. Key them along the route; patrols guard their assigned platforms and may be bypassed. Completion does not require destroying them.

nodes.name: Quarry Receipt
nodes.brief: Blackglass cut matching plates for the borrowed records. Secure the essential weigh ledger and preserve it through the copy. The exposed lift manifest and serial punch are optional evidence that also release escort equipment. Local flankers know the quarry shortcuts.

rewards.label: Evidence escort: Smelter Laser
rewards.afterword: Dispatch releases a heavy industrial emitter to the evidence escort. It hits hard at close range and generates exceptional heat. Fit and group it with care.

nodes.name: Conduit Injunction
nodes.brief: Secure the main isolator and hold it while clerks verify the live conduit serving the disputed yards. A side bypass is optional and records whether the workshop block keeps power. Expect one counterattack after verification begins.

nodes.name: Barrow Warrant
nodes.brief: Secure Barrow’s archive forecourt and protect the record room through the contractor counterattack. Keep the archive intact. The warrant supports export; the maintenance compact supports local stewardship. The commander must choose which cost to own.

nodes.name: Export Under Seal
nodes.brief: Final operation: export. Hold Barrow’s freight corridor and keep the loading stand operational until the register seals. Contractor attacks arrive through announced freight and cooling approaches. The roots leave Tessell under a lawful chain of custody.

ending.title: Export Under Seal
body: The final register travels under the Tender's Continuance seal. The Authority can trace every disputed root through the old custody chain. On paper the Recall is complete; on the ground, foundry crews watch working machines become entries in an export order.

Your company has carried out the warrant it accepted. The surviving Custodians return with a closed record, repaired seals and an account of what compliance cost. The archive preserves the answer; the people left beside the cold gantries must live with it.

nodes.name: Countersign Stewardship
nodes.brief: Final operation: local stewardship. Secure Barrow’s public desk and service reader, then protect the local handover while the Tender countersigns it. Seizure contractors oppose the recorded disposition. The roots remain on Tessell under named obligations.

ending.title: Countersigned Here
body: The Tender countersigns a century of local service as stewardship. The archive keeps the roots and their history intact, while the named machines remain under the foundries that maintained them. The Recall ends here with a lawful local reading.

Stewardship is an obligation, not an erased debt. The workshops must keep their records, crews must honour the Ironmuster Code, and your company leaves its own seal beside the countersignature. The surviving Custodians carry home proof that continuity can be defended without export.

demoSupplies.label: Demo fitting crate
demoSupplies.description: Twelve weapon types are supplied for this demo, including a few from the other faction. Try different builds early. Advanced weapons still arrive through contract rewards and battlefield salvage. The workshop automatically fits a first ammunition bin when needed; add more in the Mechlab.
